children: Indian state-owned refiners are facing their biggest supply uncertainty in months as the Middle East conflict drags on and the prospect of tighter US restrictions on Russian purchases grows, according to people with direct knowledge of the trade, Bloomberg reported.
The article did not identify specific refiners or give details on any immediate changes to buying plans.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Russian Oil Supply Uncertainty Hits India’s Biggest Buyers
